s1.syndrome_frame: Pelvic mass with chronic pelvic pain
salient_findings: Hypoechoic mass measuring approximately 6.2 cm in diameter with an irregular border over the right adnexa
Round and smooth surface mass arising from the isthmus of the right tube
key_facts: 36-year-old woman
Gravida 2, para 2
Previously diagnosed with presumed progressive uterine fibroids 6 months earlier
Presenting with right lower pelvic pain
Transabdominal sonography showed a hypoechoic mass
Computed tomography showed a moderately enhanced right adnexal tumor
Laparoscopic findings revealed a round and smooth surface mass
Pathological examination revealed a benign lesion
Frozen section revealed a benign lesion
Final pathology showed spindle cells and cords of epithelioid cells
Immunohistochemistry was positive for vimentin, desmin, smooth muscle actin, and estrogen and progesterone receptors

shortlist.label: Leiomyoma
shortlist.why_kept: Benign lesion with positive immunohistochemistry for smooth muscle actin, consistent with uterine fibroids

shortlist.label: Thecoma
shortlist.why_kept: Benign tumor with estrogen and progesterone receptor positivity, consistent with the patient's presentation

shortlist.label: Ovarian fibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Benign tumor with fibromyxoid stroma, consistent with the patient's imaging and pathological findings

shortlist.label: Adenomatoid tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Benign tumor with spindle cells and cords of epithelioid cells, consistent with the patient's pathological examination

shortlist.label: Sclerosing stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Rare benign tumor with fibromyxoid stroma and positive immunohistochemistry for vimentin and desmin, consistent with the patient's presentation

raw.rationale: The presence of spindle cells and cords of epithelioid cells around numerous blood vessels, along with positive immunohistochemistry for vimentin, desmin, smooth muscle actin, and estrogen and progesterone receptors, is consistent with an adenomatoid tumor, a type of benign neoplasm of the uterus and fallopian tubes.

rejected.label: Leiomyoma
rejected.why: While leiomyomas are common and can present with similar imaging findings, the specific histological and immunohistochemical features described are not typical of leiomyomas.

rejected.label: Thecoma
rejected.why: Thecomas are ovarian stromal tumors that typically express estrogen and progesterone receptors, but the described tumor's location and histological features do not align with a thecoma.

rejected.label: Ovarian fibroma
rejected.why: Ovarian fibromas are benign tumors of the ovary, but the described tumor's location in the right adnexa, arising from the isthmus of the right tube, and its histological features do not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Sclerosing stromal tumor
rejected.why: Sclerosing stromal tumors are rare ovarian tumors with a distinct histological appearance, which does not match the described features of this case.
